title: A $T1$ criterion for Schrödinger-Calderón-Zygmund operators with exponential decay
summary: We establish the boundedness of exponential Schrödinger-Calderón-Zygmund operators on weighted $BMO_ρ^α(w)$ spaces via a $T1$ criterion, where the weights belong to classes that capture the exponential decay of the operators, and $ρ$ is a critical radius function. Specifically, we prove that the boundedness of such an operator $T$ on $BMO_ρ^α(w)$ is equivalent to a natural oscillation condition on $T1$ over sub-critical balls.
